cues.text: 她找到我，也许只是因为我没什么名气，收费不高。
cues.textEn: Maybe she came to me because I had no reputation and didn't charge much.

cues.text: 也许只有我，才肯接下这桩赔钱的生意。
cues.textEn: Maybe I was the only one who would take a case that couldn't pay.

cues.text: 而我接下，只因为我根本没什么像样的委托可接。
cues.textEn: And I took it because I didn't have a single decent case to my name.

cues.text: 也许还因为我觉得，她的确需要帮助。
cues.textEn: Or maybe because I thought she really did need help.

cues.text: 直到现在，我还清晰地记得那一晚。那是我人生的转折点。
cues.textEn: I remember that night clearly, even now. It was the turning point of my life.
